panel.title: Survey drawing of a pillow-shaped Ifá tray (54 cm) — probably the tray in FoA_04-5588
panel.object_type: pen-and-ink survey drawing of a rectangular opon Ifá
panel.summary: A drawing captioned 'Ifabrett, Yoruba 3, greatest length 54 cm' of a cushion-shaped tray with concave sides. A large face with bared teeth flanked by hatched triangles heads the border; crowds of figures, drummers and a kneeling figure holding a round disc fill the rest.

register_readings.reading: Top (undetected): the toothed face between two hatched triangles, with seated and kneeling figures on either side.
Sides and foot (undetected): figures with staffs and bowls, drummers, tumbling bodies, and a figure holding a cross-marked disc.

panel.composition: The same arrangement as the photographed tray FoA_04-5588: a dominant face over a dense, busy rim.
panel.narrative: This sheet very probably records the same object as the photograph FoA_04-5588 — the pillow shape, the toothed face with flanking triangles and the disc-holder at the foot all match. That makes the pair a control: the draughtsman's version can be checked against the photograph, which matters because several objects in the collection survive only as drawings. The scene itself is the crowded festival-or-conflict world described for FoA_04-5588.
panel.hypotheses: Neutral. Useful as a method check rather than as evidence for either hypothesis.
cross_panel_links: Other 'Ifabrett, Yoruba 3' sheets: KBA_10300, KBA_15356, KBA_17556.
uncertainties: The identification with FoA_04-5588 is by visual match, not by catalogue number.
